mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 228.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 228.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2) and unemployment is high (UNRATE >= 7.0), the market anticipates aggressive monetary easing to combat recession, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2 and UNRATE >= 7.0, or the interaction effect (measured by the coefficient on the product term) is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a rising labor market (PAYEMS above 132000) signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS is above 132000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of employment (PAYEMS) indicate a stronger labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above 130000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) reading above 700.0 indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which stimulates economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 700.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 400000), a strong manufacturing sector (INDPRO above 95.0) signals sustained economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 and INDPRO is above 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) is above 95.0 and the economy is growing (GDPC1 above 13400.0), the combined strength in industrial production and overall economic activity drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0 and GDPC1 > 13400.0, or the interaction effect (measured by the coefficient on the product term) is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction term.
